title: Make the phase-trace contending-writer test independent of how long a store open takes on a loaded host
outcome: Make the phase-trace contending-writer test independent of how long a store open takes on a loaded host
acceptance: phase_trace::control::tests::a_contending_writer_raises_begin_immediate_at_startup proves the contention it names regardless of how long schema initialization takes: the competing writer still holds the lock when BEGIN IMMEDIATE runs, for example by handing the lock over by signal rather than holding it for a fixed time.
The test passes on master, run repeatedly in a loaded parallel environment such as DL560 with several concurrent jobs, without loosening the assertion that BEGIN IMMEDIATE waited.

completion.summary: The contending-writer regression no longer depends on schema-open timing. The exact carried candidate passed full Mac and Windows B gates, and the test passed 20/20 under four concurrent process lanes. The change is present on master 8b5495eb and installed in build f35eec36. Independent acceptance evaluation remains absent after a recorded TermAl HTTP 409; under Greg's current rule it does not block completion, and no verdict is claimed.
